description:
## What

Extract §6.1.4(k) BC cA / NotCA + §6.1.4(n) keyCertSign + §6.1.4(m) pathLenConstraint into `pub(crate) fn check_intermediate_basic_constraints(cert: &Certificate, max_path_len: &mut Option<u8>, i_non_self_issued: usize, index: usize) -> Result<()>`.

Source ranges:
- §6.1.4(k) lines 2398–2412
- §6.1.4(n) lines 2414–2425
- §6.1.4(m) lines 2427–2438

## Risk

Medium. Touches `max_path_len` and self-issued path-length counting.

## Self-issued exemption (PKIX-als9 design §5)

§6.1.4(m) `pathLenConstraint` counts only non-self-issued certs. PKITS §4.5 was the largest unmonitored regression class; fixtures imported in PKIX-77cl. H7 must preserve self-issued exemption — §4.5.1 / §4.5.3 in pkix-path tests will catch regressions.

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- chain_walk calls helper for intermediates.
- All PKITS tests pass, including §4.5.1, §4.5.3, §4.5.4, §4.5.6, §4.5.8.
- §4.6 (basic constraints) and §4.7 (key usage) tests pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: H7 — extract check_intermediate_basic_constraints (~33 lines, §6.1.4(k)+(m)+(n))
